heading: What Our Guests Say
subheading: Over 50,000 guests have experienced our hospitality. Here are some of their stories.

items.name: Andika Pratama
items.review: The Rendang Wagyu is unlike anything I've ever tasted. 8 hours of slow-cooking is evident in every single bite. This is Indonesian cuisine elevated to its absolute pinnacle.

items.name: Siti Rahayu
items.review: We've used Nusantara for three corporate events now. The catering team is impeccably professional, the food quality is consistently excellent, and they always go above and beyond.

items.name: Budi Santoso
items.review: The atmosphere alone is worth visiting for. But the food? It's a masterclass in Indonesian culinary heritage. The Ayam Betutu was perfection — spiced with extraordinary depth.

items.name: Maya Dewi
items.review: Our wedding reception was absolutely perfect. The team coordinated everything flawlessly. Guests are still talking about the food two months later. Truly a 5-star experience.

items.name: Rizal Hakim
items.review: I bring every out-of-town guest here. It never fails to impress. The Garden Terrace at sunset is magical, and the Lobster Bakar is my personal must-order every single time.

items.name: Putri Ananda
items.review: The VIP private dining room is stunning. We celebrated our anniversary here and it was absolutely perfect. Impeccable service, extraordinary food, unforgettable evening.
